The plot illustrates the relationship between the number of queries used during inference and the Mean Reciprocal Rank at 10 (MRR@10) metric. The x-axis is labeled “# of queries used during inference (S)” and has a linear scale ranging from 2 to 8, with tick labels at integer values. The y-axis is labeled “MRR@10” and has a linear scale ranging from 33.0 to 36.0, with tick labels at intervals of 0.5. There are five lines displayed on the plot. A dashed blue line with circular markers begins at approximately (2, 35.5) and ends at approximately (8, 35.7), showing a generally flat trend with minor fluctuations. A dashed green line with square markers begins at approximately (2, 34.5) and rises to a peak of approximately (6, 35.5) before declining to approximately (8, 35.0). A solid purple line with circular markers begins at approximately (2, 34.0) and ends at approximately (8, 35.0), showing a generally increasing trend. A dashed orange line with circular markers begins at approximately (2, 34.0) and ends at approximately (8, 34.5), showing a generally increasing trend. A solid red line with circular markers begins at approximately (2, 35.0) and ends at approximately (8, 35.5), showing a generally increasing trend.
